notes: Outfit creation, themed rounds and a judged runway is the Dress Up subgenre of Roleplay & Avatar Sim, with no housing model anywhere in it. Kept the Dress Up preset but replaced its stage-runway shape with space-staged, because the answers put the mall lobby and VIP wing in one continuous shared space and the runway shows on separate maps behind portals, which is exactly the lobby-isolated-from-match-area split; that P4 is stated rather than estimated, so it is not overridden, and the audience and judges stage-runway would have carried are preserved through npc-population instead. P3 comes from the VIP boutique behind the golden doors and the private per-player dressing booths, which are interiors entered from the lobby rather than facades. Decided without a user: point scoring, ranks, trading and battle passes are progression rather than layout, and both P4 and P3 are modifiers the pipeline cannot run yet, so this build should be deferred or shipped as the continuous lobby alone if it must run today.
